whyChoose.title: Why Choose
whyChoose.subtitle: We're not just a directory – we're your trusted partner in finding the perfect educational journey for your child.
whyChoose.f1Desc: AI-powered search that learns your preferences and finds schools that truly match your needs.
whyChoose.f2Desc: Every school is personally verified by our team to ensure quality and authenticity.
whyChoose.f3Desc: Live admission tracking with instant notifications for new openings and deadlines.
whyChoose.f4Desc: Connect with real families and get authentic reviews from parents just like you.
whyChoose.f5Desc: Advanced mapping with transport routes, safety ratings, and neighborhood insights.
whyChoose.f6Desc: Our rating system combines parent reviews, academic performance, and facility standards.

parentSection.subtitle: Simplify your child's educational journey with powerful tools designed for Rwandan families.
parentSection.f1Desc: Browse comprehensive school profiles with detailed information about facilities, programs, and admission requirements.
parentSection.f2Desc: Complete your school applications online with our streamlined process. Upload documents once and apply everywhere.
parentSection.f3Desc: Monitor application status in real-time with updates, and communicate directly with school administrators.
parentSection.ctaTitle: Join thousands of families already using Inzoziedu
parentSection.ctaBody: Make informed decisions about your child's education with comprehensive school data and seamless application management.

powerfulFeatures.title: Powerful Features
powerfulFeatures.subtitle: Everything you need to modernize education management in Rwanda
powerfulFeatures.f1Desc: Enterprise-grade security protecting sensitive student and school data with end-to-end encryption.
powerfulFeatures.f2Desc: Optimized performance ensures quick application processing and seamless user experience.
powerfulFeatures.f3Desc: Available in Kinyarwanda, English and French to serve all Rwandan communities.
powerfulFeatures.f4Desc: Instant messaging between schools and parents for quick updates and clarifications.
powerfulFeatures.f5Desc: Detailed insights and reports to help schools.
powerfulFeatures.f6Desc: GDPR-compliant privacy controls ensuring your personal information remains protected.

schoolOwner.subtitle: Grow your school faster with Inzoziedu—reach more parents, manage applications effortlessly, and build your reputation online.
schoolOwner.f1Desc: Easily register your school online, add details like location, programs, and contact information to increase visibility.
schoolOwner.f2Desc: Submit applications to multiple schools with our streamlined process. Upload documents once and apply everywhere.
schoolOwner.f3Desc: Send updates, respond to inquiries, and keep parents informed. Build trust through direct communication.
schoolOwner.ctaTitle: Join thousands of families already using Inzoziedu
schoolOwner.ctaBody: Make informed decisions about your child's education with comprehensive school data and seamless application management.
